title: Claude Duet: one full limit reset when you are admitted
note: Pro and Max subscribers with a US Claude account who are admitted to the Claude Duet research preview get one full limit reset, covering both the five-hour session and weekly limits. Use it by November 30, 2026 from Settings → Usage on the web or desktop ("Reset for free"). Admission is by waitlist in waves; Duet itself draws on the same plan limits as chat, including background work. Subscriber-redeemed reset credit. Stated expiry: 2026-11-30. Check Claude for account availability and the exact deadline. Not counted as an already-applied reset. Audience: Pro and Max subscribers with a US Claude account admitted to the Claude Duet research preview. Windows: five_hour, weekly. Source: @AnthropicAI https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17631495-get-started-with-claude-duet
